test.//: Default (in-process) lane. The suite that loads this package's OWN built dist/index.mjs (dist-artifact-smoke) moved to a sibling `*.e2e.ts` file under the on-demand `e2e` target, so the default lane no longer builds this package. Override of the inferred `test` target carries only `dependsOn` (`lint`/`^build`) plus `inputs` excluding `*.e2e.ts`; executor/cache/outputs come from inference.
test.//inputs: Exclude *.e2e.ts so editing a resource-consuming suite never invalidates the default lane's cache — it never runs those files (its vitest `include` is `src/**/*.spec.ts`, see vite.config.ts). Mirrors the workspace targetDefaults.test inputs plus the negative pattern.

e2e.//: Resource-consuming lane: runs ONLY the `*.e2e.ts` suites extracted out of the default `test` target (the CPU-heavy real ts-morph/TypeScript compilation suites, plus two spawnSync subprocess specs). REACHABILITY (2026-09-28, backlog-e2e-cache-separation): it is NOT in any `test.dependsOn` (the default lane stays fast), but it IS reached by the push/CI gate's `nx affected -t e2e` — the gate's target list is canonicalised in `tools/gate/lane-gate.mjs` (`GATE_TARGETS = ['test','e2e']`), which `.githooks/pre-push` and both CI workflows consume — and by `publish` via the conditional in `tools/nx-plugins/build/plugin.js` (`hasE2e ? ["e2e"] : []`). It is cached (`cache:true` + `inputs`) so a repeat gate run is a cache HIT, never an uncached re-run. `dependsOn: ["build"]` because the moved suite spawns the shipped `dist/index.mjs`. Its coverage dir is DISTINCT from the default lane's, and declares no dist-shaped output.
